note: An SSML audio tag supplies attacker-controlled src text that is copied into a local filename buffer.
The copied src string is passed into the sound-icon loader as the file path to cache and load.
The loader assumes the table slot is valid and writable; the safety obligation is that n_soundicon_tab must still refer to an allocated live slot before writing the filename pointer.
Later synthesis dereferences the cached sound-icon entry and uses the stored data pointer after the table entry has been invalidated, producing the use-after-free read.
